text:
Alana: Quick heads-up — CI publish step failed on main when running typegen for samplekit. regen-diff is non-empty and shows a reorder of optional params in CreateUserOpts. Anyone seen this?
Mike: I hit a similar local regen earlier today. Looks like property ordering in the OpenAPI spec is nondeterministic.
bot-regendiff: regendiff report: files changed: src/apis/user.ts (24 insertions, 19 deletions). Diff: https://ci.redwood/regen/4826 (truncated).
Sara: The changelog generator classified it as a 'refactor' which is flipping the semver decision to minor. That will block a patch-only publish.
Priya: This is blocking the samplekit npm publish step — our publish workflow refuses to proceed if regen-diff isn't empty. Can we fix typegen ordering or normalize output?
Alana: Repro steps I ran: `git checkout main && ./scripts/typegen --write && git status --porcelain` showed modified files. Snippet from the generated signature: ```ts
export type CreateUserOpts = { locale?: string; displayName?: string; email?: string }
// then later order becomes displayName, email, locale
```
Mike: I patched my local openapi generator to set sortProperties: true and that stabilized output for me, but not sure about side effects for other SDKs.
Sara: Adding a generator flag might be invasive. Alternative: add a post-typegen normalization that sorts optional params alphabetically before emission — keeps generator unchanged but stabilizes TS output.
DevExOps: For the short term we can relax the publish gate by adding a rule in publish.yaml to allow non-functional reorders (optional-only param reorder) as patch. But we need a deterministic rule and a failing test to avoid regressions.
Alana: Proposed action items: (1) Priya to open a normalization PR (post-typegen) with golden-file tests, (2) Mike to run the full SDK compatibility matrix to verify no downstream breakage, (3) I will temporarily unblock the samplekit publish gate for this release so onboarding isn't blocked. ETA end of day.
Priya: Starting branch `priya/normalize-typegen`. I'll add a unit that canonicalizes param lists and an integration test that runs regen twice and asserts no diffs.
bot-ci: Build 4827 queued for branch priya/normalize-typegen. Tests: unit, integ, regen-check.
Mike: I'll run the JS/Go/Rust SDK consumers locally once your branch is up. If we see any runtime mismatch we'll revert.
Sara: Also updating the release notes checklist: add "typegen deterministic output" as manual verification until PR is merged.
DevExOps: Filed release issue #6129 and added a temporary label `publish-unblock` for samplekit. Don't forget to remove after fix.
Alana: Thanks — ping here when the PR is ready and I'll re-run the publish job.
Priya: Will do. Expect a draft PR in ~2 hours.
bot-ci: CI started: build 4827. ETA ~12m.
Mike: Nice, thanks. Adding a note to the onboarding doc so folks know how to handle this if they hit it again. :memo:
Sara: Great teamwork. If the normalization looks safe we can backport to the last release to reduce churn for other packages.
Alana: Agreed. End of thread for now — follow-up in PR.
